_comment: Accepted/known accessibility debt for the Upgrades tab, seeded from a real layout-gate run at fork 9b407a5f3 on 2026-09-19 (stage visual-a11y-reviewer), and re-seeded at fork baf02292d on 2026-09-19 after tickets 444/445/446 were fixed (their entries removed; they no longer fire). Each entry is a (ruleId, selector) axe reports; scripts/check_layout_gate.py passes this file to the fork test-layout.mjs via TBC_A11Y_BASELINE, so these are tracked debt and only NEW critical/serious WCAG violations block pnpm merge-to-dev. Every entry carries EITHER a ticket (a fix is owed) OR a wontfix reason. An entry that no longer fires prints a stale-baseline WARN and should be removed. Re-seed after a fix or a tab change with TBC_A11Y_DUMP=<path> pnpm layout-gate:check, then rebuild this file from the dump (dedupe on ruleId+selector, sort, assign ticket/reason).

entries.reason: wontfix: inherited site theme (Bootstrap .btn-outline-danger, #dc3545 on the dark theme background); the borrow-native-styling rule keeps upstream theme colours
